initiatives.name: Mutual Aid Network of Anchorage (MANA)
initiatives.description: Volunteer network in Anchorage that pairs neighbors who need help with volunteers for grocery deliveries, wellness checks, yard work and navigating social services. Fiscally sponsored by AKPIRG.

initiatives.name: Food for Thought Alaska
initiatives.description: Anchorage food activism group founded in 2018 that runs a network of free community fridges in neighborhoods including Fairview, Muldoon, Mountain View, Spenard and Government Hill.

initiatives.name: Choosing Our Roots
initiatives.description: Queer-led and queer-focused nonprofit providing housing support and case management to queer, Alaskan youth and young adults experiencing housing insecurity and homelessness.
